# Physics and navigation

Rigid bodies, colliders, characters, joints, vehicles, world settings and navigation.

## `body` { #body }

Simulated rigid body (Jolt). dynamic = moved by forces and collisions, kinematic = moved by its transform (platforms, doors) and pushes dynamic bodies, static = never moves. Needs no collider: the shape is fitted to the mesh. Child entities with a collider (and no body of their own) become parts of this body.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `motion` | string | How the body moves | `dynamic` `static` `kinematic` |
| `mass` | number | Mass in kg (crate 20, person 70, car 1200) | 0.001 .. 10000000 |
| `friction` | number | Surface friction (ice 0.05, wood 0.5, rubber 1) | 0 .. 10 |
| `restitution` | number | Bounciness: 0 = no bounce, 1 = perfectly elastic | 0 .. 1 |
| `linearDamping` | number | Air drag on movement | 0 .. 100 |
| `angularDamping` | number | Drag on spinning | 0 .. 100 |
| `gravityScale` | number | Gravity multiplier (0 = floats, -1 = falls up) | -100 .. 100 |
| `lockPosition` | string | World axes along which the body cannot move ("z" for 2D games) | `none` `x` `y` `z` `xy` `xz` `yz` `xyz` |
| `lockRotation` | string | World axes around which the body cannot rotate ("xz" stays upright) | `none` `x` `y` `z` `xy` `xz` `yz` `xyz` |
| `ccd` | boolean | Continuous collision detection: fast objects never tunnel through walls |  |
| `startAwake` | boolean | Simulate from the start (false = sleep until touched) |  |
| `velocity` | number[3] | Linear velocity m/s (initial; live while playing, writable) |  |
| `angularVelocity` | number[3] | Angular velocity in degrees/s (initial; live while playing) |  |
| `layer` | string | Collision layer (which layers collide: physics_world.ignorePairs) | `default` `static` `player` `enemy` `projectile` `trigger` `debris` |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"body": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.body.motion          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `collider` { #collider }

Collision shape. Alone it makes static geometry (walls, floors); with a body it shapes the body. auto fits the mesh (box/sphere/capsule/cylinder for primitives, convex hull for dynamic models, triangle mesh for static models). mesh = exact triangles (static/kinematic only); convex = hull of the mesh; heightfield = terrain. isTrigger makes a sensor zone that fires `on trigger_enter` / `on trigger_exit` instead of blocking.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shape` | string | Shape type | `auto` `box` `sphere` `capsule` `cylinder` `convex` `mesh` `heightfield` |
| `size` | number[3] | Box: full size (local units); heightfield: x/z extent, y = max height |  |
| `radius` | number | Sphere/capsule/cylinder radius (local units) | 0.001 .. 100000 |
| `height` | number | Capsule/cylinder total height along local Y | 0.001 .. 100000 |
| `offset` | number[3] | Shape center relative to the entity origin (local) |  |
| `rotation` | number[3] | Shape rotation relative to the entity (Euler degrees) |  |
| `isTrigger` | boolean | Sensor: detects overlaps (trigger_enter/exit) but never blocks |  |
| `friction` | number | Material friction override (-1 = use the body's) | -1 .. 10 |
| `restitution` | number | Material bounciness override (-1 = use the body's) | -1 .. 1 |
| `heightmap` | string | Heightfield source, project-relative: 16-bit .r16/.raw (square) or .hdr; empty = sample the mesh |  |
| `resolution` | integer | Heightfield samples per side (8..1024) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"collider": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.collider.shape          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `character` { #character }

Capsule character controller: walks up slopes and stairs, slides along walls, rides moving platforms, pushes dynamic bodies and is detected by triggers. Drive it from Wander every tick: walk(self, dir), jump(self), grounded(self). Units are meters (not scaled by the transform).

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `height` | number | Capsule height in m | 0.1 .. 50 |
| `radius` | number | Capsule radius in m | 0.05 .. 10 |
| `offset` | number[3] | Capsule center relative to the entity origin in m (y = height/2 for models with the origin at the feet) |  |
| `maxSlope` | number | Steepest walkable slope in degrees | 0 .. 89 |
| `stepHeight` | number | Highest step/curb climbed automatically (m) | 0 .. 5 |
| `moveSpeed` | number | Walking speed in m/s for walk(self, dir) with \|dir\| = 1 | 0 .. 100 |
| `jumpSpeed` | number | Upward speed of jump() in m/s | 0 .. 100 |
| `gravity` | number | Downward acceleration in m/s^2 | 0 .. 200 |
| `airControl` | number | Steering while airborne (0 none .. 1 full) | 0 .. 1 |
| `turnSpeed` | number | Degrees/s to turn toward the walk direction (0 = off) | 0 .. 100000 |
| `pushStrength` | number | Max force in N used to push dynamic bodies | 0 .. 1000000 |
| `mass` | number | Mass in kg | 1 .. 100000 |
| `layer` | string | Collision layer | `default` `static` `player` `enemy` `projectile` `trigger` `debris` |
| `velocity` | number[3] | Current velocity m/s (live while playing; write for knockback) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"character": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.character.height          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `joint` { #joint }

Connects this entity's body to another body (`target`) or to the world. fixed = welded; hinge = doors, wheels, levers (axis, limits in degrees, motor); ball = chains, ragdoll shoulders; slider = pistons, drawers (axis, limits in m); distance = rope/rod (limits = min/max length); spring = bouncy link (stiffness Hz, damping). Breaks above breakForce (fires `on event "joint_broken"` on this entity).

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | Joint type | `fixed` `hinge` `ball` `slider` `distance` `spring` |
| `target` | object \| string \| integer \| null | Other entity (name, #id or {"id"}); empty = attached to the world — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links) |  |
| `anchor` | number[3] | Pivot point in this entity's local space |  |
| `connectedAnchor` | number[3] | distance/spring: the other end in the target's local space (a world point when attached to the world) |  |
| `axis` | number[3] | Hinge axis / slider direction in local space |  |
| `limitMin` | number | Lower limit: degrees (hinge), m (slider, distance); used when min &lt; max |  |
| `limitMax` | number | Upper limit |  |
| `motorSpeed` | number | Motor target speed: degrees/s (hinge) or m/s (slider) |  |
| `motorForce` | number | Motor max torque (N m) or force (N); 0 = no motor | 0 .. 1000000000 |
| `stiffness` | number | Spring frequency in Hz (spring joints) | 0 .. 1000 |
| `damping` | number | Spring damping ratio (0 = bouncy, 1 = critically damped) | 0 .. 100 |
| `breakForce` | number | Breaks when the joint force exceeds this (N); 0 = unbreakable | 0 .. 999999995904 |
| `collideConnected` | boolean | Let the two connected bodies collide with each other |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | Active (set to false when the joint breaks) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"joint": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.joint.kind          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `vehicle` { #vehicle }

Drivable wheeled vehicle (Jolt vehicle constraint): suspension, tire friction curves, engine torque curve, auto/manual gearbox, FWD/RWD/AWD limited-slip differentials, anti-roll bars, downforce and drag. Needs a dynamic `body` on the same entity (the chassis). Child entities named wheel* are the wheels (fitted automatically when `wheels` is empty) and spin/steer/bounce while playing. Drive it with the inputs (throttle, brake, steer, handbrake): control=player reads the drive input actions, or set them from Wander (vehicle_drive(self, ...)). Build one with vehicle_create, tune by numbers with vehicle_tune + vehicle_test_drive, watch it with vehicle_info.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | string | Preset it was built from (informational): sports, hatchback, truck, kart, custom |  |
| `mass` | number | Chassis mass in kg (kart 160, hatchback 1150, sports 1350, truck 2600) | 1 .. 1000000 |
| `centerOfMass` | number[3] | Center-of-mass offset in m (local); lower y = less body roll, harder to flip |  |
| `maxTilt` | number | Max pitch/roll in degrees before the chassis is held upright (180 = can flip) | 5 .. 180 |
| `wheels` | object[] | Per-wheel setup in chassis space; empty = fitted at play from children named wheel*. Any field overrides the vehicle default for that wheel |  |
| `wheelRadius` | number | Wheel radius in m (0 = measured from the wheel meshes) | 0 .. 10 |
| `wheelWidth` | number | Wheel width in m (0 = measured) | 0 .. 10 |
| `suspensionMinLength` | number | Suspension length fully compressed (m below the mount) | 0 .. 5 |
| `suspensionMaxLength` | number | Suspension length fully extended (m below the mount) | 0.01 .. 5 |
| `suspensionFrequency` | number | Spring frequency in Hz (1 soft, 1.6 road, 2.5+ race) | 0.1 .. 20 |
| `suspensionDamping` | number | Damping ratio (0.3 floaty, 0.5 road, 1 stiff) | 0 .. 5 |
| `steering` | string | Which wheels steer | `front` `rear` `all` `none` |
| `maxSteerAngle` | number | Steering lock in degrees | 0 .. 89 |
| `brakeTorque` | number | Brake torque per wheel in N m at full brake | 0 .. 1000000 |
| `handbrakeTorque` | number | Handbrake torque per rear wheel in N m | 0 .. 1000000 |
| `longitudinalGrip` | number | Peak tire friction accelerating/braking (1 economy tires, 1.25 sports, 1.6 slicks) | 0 .. 10 |
| `lateralGrip` | number | Peak tire friction cornering: about the skidpad g (0.9 hatchback, 1.1 sports; lower = slides sooner) | 0 .. 10 |
| `longitudinalCurve` | number[2][] | Tire friction vs slip ratio [[slip, 0..1], ...] (scaled by longitudinalGrip); empty = default |  |
| `lateralCurve` | number[2][] | Tire friction vs slip angle [[degrees, 0..1], ...] (scaled by lateralGrip); empty = default |  |
| `drive` | string | Driven wheels | `fwd` `rwd` `awd` |
| `frontTorqueSplit` | number | AWD: share of the torque sent to the front axle | 0 .. 1 |
| `limitedSlip` | number | Limited-slip ratio of the differentials (1.4 tight, &gt;= 10 open) | 1.01 .. 1000000 |
| `differentialRatio` | number | Final drive ratio | 0.1 .. 50 |
| `maxTorque` | number | Peak engine torque in N m | 0 .. 1000000 |
| `minRpm` | number | Idle rpm | 0 .. 30000 |
| `maxRpm` | number | Redline rpm | 100 .. 30000 |
| `engineInertia` | number | Engine inertia in kg m^2 (lower revs faster) | 0.01 .. 100 |
| `engineDamping` | number | Engine braking / internal friction | 0 .. 10 |
| `torqueCurve` | number[2][] | Torque vs rpm [[rpm fraction, torque fraction], ...]; empty = default |  |
| `transmission` | string | Gearbox: auto shifts by rpm; manual uses vehicle_shift / shift actions | `auto` `manual` |
| `gearRatios` | number[] | Forward gear ratios, first gear first; empty = [2.66, 1.78, 1.3, 1.0, 0.74] |  |
| `reverseRatio` | number | Reverse gear ratio (magnitude) | 0.1 .. 50 |
| `shiftUpRpm` | number | Auto gearbox shifts up above this rpm | 100 .. 30000 |
| `shiftDownRpm` | number | Auto gearbox shifts down below this rpm | 50 .. 30000 |
| `shiftTime` | number | Seconds without drive while shifting | 0 .. 5 |
| `clutchStrength` | number | Clutch coupling strength | 0.1 .. 1000 |
| `antiRollFront` | number | Front anti-roll bar (0 none, 300 soft, 700 sporty, 2000 very stiff; above ~4000 the body can shake) | 0 .. 20000 |
| `antiRollRear` | number | Rear anti-roll bar (stiffer than the front = more oversteer) | 0 .. 20000 |
| `downforce` | number | Aero downforce in N per (m/s)^2 (0.4 road car, 2+ race car) | 0 .. 1000 |
| `drag` | number | Aero drag in N per (m/s)^2 (limits top speed; ~0.5 * rho * Cd * area) | 0 .. 1000 |
| `control` | string | Who sets the inputs: player = drive input actions, script = Wander/tools, none | `player` `script` `none` |
| `steerSpeed` | number | Steering response: full lock per second (0 = instant) | 0 .. 100 |
| `speedSensitiveSteering` | number | Less steering lock at speed, 0..1 | 0 .. 1 |
| `tractionControl` | boolean | Traction control: limits wheelspin under throttle |  |
| `abs` | boolean | Anti-lock brakes: keeps the wheels rolling (and steering) under hard braking |  |
| `driftAssist` | number | Arcade drift help 0..1: easy slides that hold their angle | 0 .. 1 |
| `autoReverse` | boolean | Holding brake at a standstill reverses |  |
| `engineAudio` | boolean | Drive the entity's audio component: pitch from rpm, volume from load |  |
| `throttle` | number | Input: accelerator 0..1 (live) | 0 .. 1 |
| `brake` | number | Input: brake pedal 0..1 (live) | 0 .. 1 |
| `steer` | number | Input: steering -1 left .. 1 right (live) | -1 .. 1 |
| `handbrake` | number | Input: handbrake 0..1 (live) | 0 .. 1 |
| `gear` | integer | Current gear (-1 reverse, 0 neutral); manual gearbox: write to shift |  |
| `speed` | number | Telemetry: km/h along the heading (negative reversing) |  |
| `rpm` | number | Telemetry: engine rpm |  |
| `wheelsOnGround` | integer | Telemetry: wheels touching the ground |  |
| `skid` | number | Telemetry: strongest tire slide 0..1 (tire smoke, skid marks, squeal) |  |

## `chase_camera` { #chase_camera }

Spring-arm chase camera: follows `target` from behind with look-ahead into corners, collision pull-in and a field of view that widens with speed. Put it on an entity with a camera (vehicle_create chase_camera=true sets it up). Moves every tick while playing.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | object \| string \| integer \| null | Entity to follow (the vehicle) — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links) |  |
| `distance` | number | Distance behind the target in m | 0 .. 1000 |
| `height` | number | Height above the target in m | -100 .. 1000 |
| `targetHeight` | number | Aim point above the target origin in m | -100 .. 100 |
| `lookAhead` | number | Seconds of velocity to aim ahead | 0 .. 5 |
| `stiffness` | number | Position spring in 1/s (higher = tighter) | 0.1 .. 100 |
| `turnStiffness` | number | How fast the arm swings behind the target in 1/s | 0.1 .. 100 |
| `fovMin` | number | Field of view at a standstill (degrees) | 5 .. 170 |
| `fovMax` | number | Field of view at fovSpeed (degrees) | 5 .. 170 |
| `fovSpeed` | number | Speed in m/s where the field of view reaches fovMax | 0.1 .. 1000 |
| `collide` | boolean | Pull the camera in when a wall blocks the view |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"chase_camera": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.chase_camera.target          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `physics_world` { #physics_world }

Scene-wide physics settings. One per scene (on any entity; the physics_settings tool manages it).

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gravity` | number[3] | Gravity in m/s^2 (Earth [0,-9.81,0], Moon [0,-1.62,0]) |  |
| `substeps` | integer | Collision steps per tick (1..8; more = stabler stacks, fast objects) |  |
| `ignorePairs` | string | Comma-separated layer pairs that never collide, e.g. "debris-player, projectile-projectile" (layers: default, static, player, enemy, projectile, trigger, debris) |  |
| `allowSleep` | boolean | Let resting bodies sleep (much cheaper) |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | Run the physics simulation while playing |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"physics_world": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.physics_world.gravity          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `navmesh` { #navmesh }

Navigation-mesh bake settings and the saved bake (one per scene; nav_build creates it). Walkable surfaces come from static colliders and static meshes.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agentRadius` | number | Agent radius in m (walls are eroded by it) | 0 .. 20 |
| `agentHeight` | number | Agent height in m (lower ceilings block) | 0.1 .. 50 |
| `maxClimb` | number | Highest step in m | 0 .. 20 |
| `maxSlope` | number | Steepest walkable slope in degrees | 0 .. 89 |
| `cellSize` | number | Voxel size in m (radius/2..radius/3 is typical) | 0.01 .. 5 |
| `cellHeight` | number | Voxel height in m | 0.01 .. 5 |
| `tileSize` | integer | Cells per tile side (16..256) |  |
| `geometry` | string | Input: both (colliders where present, else meshes), colliders only, or render meshes only | `both` `colliders` `meshes` |
| `data` | string | Baked navmesh file (project-relative), written by nav_build |  |
| `autoBuild` | boolean | Bake when play starts if the saved bake is missing or stale |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"navmesh": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.navmesh.agentRadius          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `nav_agent` { #nav_agent }

Path-finding agent on the navigation mesh with local avoidance (crowds). Wander: navigate(self, target), stop_navigation(self), arrived(self); fires `on event "arrived"`. With a character component it walks the controller; otherwise it moves the transform.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | number | Max speed in m/s | 0 .. 100 |
| `acceleration` | number | Acceleration in m/s^2 | 0.01 .. 1000 |
| `radius` | number | Radius used for avoidance in m | 0.05 .. 20 |
| `height` | number | Height in m | 0.1 .. 50 |
| `stoppingDistance` | number | Arrival tolerance in m | 0 .. 100 |
| `turnSpeed` | number | Degrees/s to face the movement (0 = never rotate) | 0 .. 100000 |
| `destination` | number[3] | World point to walk to (with navigating = true) |  |
| `navigating` | boolean | Heading to the destination (cleared on arrival) |  |
| `autoRepath` | boolean | Re-plan when blocked or when the destination changes |  |
| `avoidance` | string | Local avoidance quality | `none` `low` `medium` `high` |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"nav_agent": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.nav_agent.speed          -- read or write any field
    ```
